reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.body: I’d give these 5 stars. They are easy to use, gentle on my skin, and work really well for removing peach fuzz and cleaning up my eyebrows. I also love using them for quick touch-ups around my upper lip and jawline. They leave my skin feeling smoother, and makeup applies more evenly afterward. Great value for the number you get, definitely keeping these on hand.
